definitions.ask: Should Command-\ get its own Settings toggle, so it can be turned off without giving up Control-Shift-Command-I?
definitions.why: Global Command-\ steals the chord from every app (e.g. 1Password autofill); keep an off switch

choices.label: Default-on Settings toggle re-registers Command-\ live; off keeps Control-Shift-Command-I
No new setting; Command-\ always registers at launch and on Recheck Bob
